newsitem.title: ITALY: STET savings reopen down after suspension.
newsitem.headline: STET savings reopen down after suspension.

text.p: Shares in the savings shares of Italian telecom holding STET reopened down around 19.99 percent after being earlier suspensed on the Milan bourse, but savings shares in Telecom Italia remained suspended.
STET savings shares reopened around 1110 GMT after trading margins were widened to 20 percent from 10 percent, and the shares were last quoted down 17.75 percent at 5,530 lire.
Shares in Telecom Italia savings shares remained suspended despite the trading margin also being widened to 20 percent.

The two savings shares were suspended after falling sharply on Monday after the Italian Treasury said on Friday that these savings shares would not be converted into ordinary shares when STET and Telecom Italia are merged.
